reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is factually correct: lines 275-276 in get_data_column_sidecars add entire cells/proofs arrays instead of indexing by column_index, causing each sidecar to contain CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cells per blob instead of 1 cell per blob. However, the buggy function is DEAD CODE—grep confirms it is never invoked anywhere in the codebase. All production paths use assemble_data_column_sidecars (L335-336) which correctly indexes cells[rowIndex][columnIndex]. Per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json out_of_scope: 'code that cannot be exploited when the client is running' and 'anything that cannot be exploited on a live network' are excluded. Since the function is unreachable, the bug cannot affect any node on the network. 01e source: outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json L756-773, invariant text: 'Each sidecar must contain exactly one cell and one proof per blob in the block.' The spec is correct but the code violates it only in dead code.
